name: Sarkoth
label: Quest

intro: Having avenged the wounded troll Hana'zua by slaying the monstrous scorpid Sarkoth, an adventurer must carry word of his plight back to the Den. Gornek must be alerted so that rescue can reach the stricken scout before his venomous wounds claim his life.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!
But it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. Please, friend, return to the Den and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.

However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, friend. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
